name: Pink Guava 1g Live Resin Disposable
description: Lineage: Nepali Pink x Guava Type: Hybrid Terpenes: ß-Caryophyllene, Linalool, Limonene Aroma: Tropical, Funky, Creamy Effects: Euphoric, Relaxed, Hungry Dive into the tropics with Pink Guava, a strain that's a vibrant symphony of flavor and relaxation. Picture buds that blush with hues of pink, like a tropical sunset over a serene beach. The aroma is an exotic dance of sweet guava with hints of citrus, transporting you to a lush paradise with every inhale. As you savor the tropical infusion, Pink Guava's effects ripple through your senses, offering a perfect balance of tranquility and euphoria. Embrace the exotic allure of Pink Guava - your passport to a paradise of blissful highs.
